posts:
Lawmakers push AB 2599 requiring big firms to disclose slavery ties.
Evidence: disclosure mandate, insurance pushback, funding requirement
#Aletheia #USPol

Proponents claim the bill brings historical accountability and transparency.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.5) — Good Preference

Critics note it duplicates old laws and lacks immediate funding for databases.
Resulting Judgement: (+0.3, -0.2) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Redemption.
Legislative transparency addresses historic harms despite administrative friction.
Integrity: Trustworthy (Hypocrisy: 1.2, z: 1)

- AB 2599 Mandate: PASS (+0.4, -0.1) — Demands corporate transparency.
- Insurance Pushback: COND (-0.2, -0.3) — Cites redundant existing regulations.
California's legislature passed AB 2599 requiring firms with $100M+ revenue to file affidavits detailing historic ties to slavery.

The Bright Side:
Encourages corporate record-checking and historical reckoning regarding past economic dependencies.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses procedural paperwork (WHAT) with structural restitution (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
By imposing mandatory disclosure without direct punitive seizure, the bill trades genuine material amends for bureaucratic optics, substituting transparency for reparations.

The Trajectory: The Path of Redemption.
When you map institutional transparency against bureaucratic friction, it plots a moderate course toward structured accountability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Historical records reveal corporate complicity in foundational economic injustices.

The Unavoidable Lie: Bureaucratic disclosure forms constitute direct economic reparation.

Alethekanon:
Mandated record disclosure exposes historical complicity but stops short of substantive material restitution.

Awwthekanon:
May this accounting bring truth to light and honor those whose labor built our world.

Brothekanon:
Filling out a spreadsheet isn't quite a check, but it's a start.

Spirithekanon:
"Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to act." Proverbs 3:27 PASS
Accountability demands reckoning with past debts when truth comes to light.
